send.description: Schedule a message to be sent later, in Vietnam time (UTC+7)

copy.description: Schedule a copy of a message to be sent later, in Vietnam time (UTC+7)

get.description: List the scheduled messages of this server

messageOption.description: Text to send; leave empty to write it in a dialog

messageLinkOption.description: Link of the message to copy at the scheduled time

destinationOption.description: Channel to send it to (default: this channel)

idOption.description: Number of the scheduled message to cancel

when.TIME_REQUIRED: Enter a time, for example 14:30 or 30m.
when.INVALID_TIME: Cannot read {input} as a time. Use 14:30, or a span from now such as 30m, 2h or 1h30m.
when.INVALID_DATE: Cannot read {input} as a date. Use today, tomorrow, 20/10 or 20/10/2026.
when.NONEXISTENT_DATE: {input} is not a day on the calendar.
when.RELATIVE_WITH_DATE: A time like 30m already counts from now; leave the date empty.
when.PAST: That moment has already passed: {input}. Choose a later time.

created: Job has been scheduled with id {seq} at {when}

notPending.SENDING: Scheduled message {seq} is being sent right now and can no longer be canceled.
notPending.SENT: Scheduled message {seq} was already sent and cannot be canceled.
notPending.FAILED: Scheduled message {seq} already failed and cannot be canceled.

failure.SOURCE_GONE: The message to copy no longer exists.
failure.SOURCE_EMPTY: The message to copy has no text or files.
failure.CHANNEL_GONE: The destination channel is gone or the bot cannot see it.
failure.NO_PERMISSION: The bot may not send messages in the destination channel.
failure.GUILD_MISMATCH: The message to copy is not from this server.
failure.CREATOR_LOST_ACCESS: The person who scheduled it can no longer manage this server.
failure.KEY_REVOKED: The API key that scheduled it was revoked.
failure.SEND_REJECTED: Discord refused the message (it may be too long or not allowed).

problem.SCHEDULE_LIMIT: This server already has {max} scheduled messages waiting. Cancel some or wait for them to be sent.
problem.TOO_FAR: Messages can be scheduled at most {days} days ahead. Choose an earlier time.
problem.EMPTY_SOURCE: The message to copy has no text or attachment.
problem.TOO_LONG: The message to copy is longer than 2000 characters, which the bot cannot send.
problem.FILES_TOO_LARGE: The files of the message to copy are larger than the destination server accepts.
